intro: We are always interested in hearing from curious, motivated people who want to study how beliefs, expectations and social context shape pain, emotion and the body.

openings.title: Principal Neuroscientist: Evans Family Professor of Psychiatry and Neuroscience
Undergraduate research assistants
openings.blurb: Dartmouth undergraduates interested in joining the lab as research assistants can apply through this form.

general.title: Postdoctoral researchers
general.blurb: Postdoctoral positions are advertised as they open. Candidates with a background in neuroimaging, computational modelling, pain or affective neuroscience are encouraged to send a CV, a short statement of interests and the names of two references to Tor Wager.

general.title: Graduate students
general.blurb: Graduate students join through the Dartmouth Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences (Cognitive Neuroscience) PhD program. Mention CANlab and Tor Wager in your application.

general.title: Visiting scholars
general.blurb: We regularly host visiting faculty, postdocs and students for collaborative projects. Get in touch with a description of the project you have in mind.

participate.title: Participate in a study
participate.intro: Research opportunities at Dartmouth College, Hanover NH.

studies.title: Brain imaging study of a heat-management cream
studies.blurb: Seeking healthy individuals 18+ years old for a clinical trial of a heat management cream. This brain imaging (fMRI) study includes 3 in-person sessions and a 40-60 minute online survey. Contribute to our understanding of pain management and receive up to $350 upon completion of all of the study's parts.
